# Results (draft generated by the pipeline — verify and edit before submission)

## Sample
Of 4,424 students (0 exact duplicates removed), 1,421 (32.1%) dropped out, 794 (17.9%)
remained enrolled and 2,209 (49.9%) graduated (Table 1). The development set comprised 3,539 students
and the locked holdout 885 (Fig. 1).

## RQ1 — Discrimination
In repeated nested cross-validation, mean macro-F1 ranged from 0.700
(Logistic regression) to 0.725
(Soft voting); the calibrated multinomial LR reached 0.700 ± 0.017 (Table 2).
The Friedman test indicated differences between models (χ²(8) =
25.36, p = 0.001; Iman–Davenport F(8, 72) = 4.18, p = <0.001; critical difference =
3.80; Fig. 2c). Compared with the LR, 1 of 8 candidates were superior in macro-F1 after Holm
adjustment, and 1 exceeded the practical margin of 0.01 (Table 3, panel A). Relative to
their comparators, the meta-ensembles were: Soft voting vs XGBoost +0.009 (−0.006 to +0.025), P(better) = 0.45, inconclusive; Stacking vs XGBoost −0.004 (−0.025 to +0.017), P(better) = 0.09, inconclusive (Table 3, panel B). F1 for the Enrolled class was
the lowest for every model (range 0.483–0.525). Soft voting was
selected by the prespecified tolerance hierarchy. On the holdout it achieved a macro-F1 of
0.743 (0.711–0.773) versus 0.708 for the LR
(Δ +0.035 (+0.007 to +0.061); Tables 5–6).

## RQ2 — Calibration
Temperature scaling changed the class-wise ECE of Soft voting from 0.054 to
0.039 in cross-validation (Table 4; Table S5). On the holdout, the
class-wise ECE was 0.036 and the ECE for Enrolled 0.026 (Dropout
0.034; Graduate 0.048); the multiclass Brier score was 0.3031.
One-vs-rest calibration slopes were Dropout 0.99, Enrolled 1.00, Graduate 0.98 and intercepts
Dropout +0.07, Enrolled −0.15, Graduate +0.10 (Table 6, Fig. 3). Expected and observed class counts
are compared in Table S9; capacity-based prioritisation is reported in Table 7 and Fig. 4.

## RQ3 — Explainability
The most influential predictors by mean absolute SHAP value were Curricular units 2nd sem (approved), Curricular units 1st sem (approved), Tuition fees up to date, Curricular units 2nd sem (grade), Scholarship holder (Table 8, Fig. 5).
Global concordance: SHAP vs permutation: τ = 0.65, top-10 Jaccard = 0.67; SHAP vs LIME (aggregated): τ = 0.41, top-10 Jaccard = 0.54; Permutation vs LIME (aggregated): τ = 0.34, top-10 Jaccard = 0.54. LIME status: median R² 0.342; not reportable (low fidelity). Fidelity, local agreement and stability are reported in
Tables S7–S8; a local explanation for a student in the Enrolled class is shown in Fig. 6.

## Sensitivity analyses
Macro-F1 by prediction horizon: Enrolment only: 0.575; Enrolment + 1st semester: 0.692; End of first year (all): 0.722
(Table 9, Fig. 7).
